description: A non-streamed Gemini request with generation options, a thinking budget, a systemInstruction and toolConfig mode ANY naming one function, to a Messages upstream: the options and the one allowed function reach the Messages request (the thinking budget is reported as dropped: Messages budgets depend on the model), and the tool_use reply comes back as a functionCall.
source: core/internal/translator/claude/gemini/claude_gemini_request.go (maxOutputTokens to max_tokens, topP to top_p, stopSequences to stop_sequences; thinkingConfig budget to Claude thinking; systemInstruction to a separate user message; toolConfig ANY with one allowed name to tool_choice of that tool)

exceptions.reason: The new core writes the Gemini reply the same way for every upstream format: candidate index 0, one chunk per text or thought delta, a last chunk holding the finish reason, any function calls and usageMetadata with Gemini's inclusion rules (promptTokenCount counts every input token, cache reads included, in cachedContentTokenCount), and max_tokens as MAX_TOKENS. Today's Claude translator adds createTime and usageMetadata.trafficType PROVISIONED_THROUGHPUT, leaves out the candidate index, reports a promptTokenCount of 0, maps a non-streamed max_tokens stop to STOP, and turns a Claude thinking signature into a thought part holding skip_thought_signature_validator, Google's last-resort value that skips validation; the new core does not invent a signature and reports the Claude one as dropped.

Today's core reaches a Messages upstream only through its Claude API-key provider and its Gemini-to-Claude translator, which rewrite the request even for a custom base URL: cache_control breakpoints, a metadata.user_id hashed from the request, $schema and additionalProperties false on tool schemas, the system instruction sent as a user message, temperature and top_p dropped, every request streamed, ?beta=true, and the key as a bearer token with its own Accept and Accept-Encoding. The new core sends a plain Messages request: the system instruction as system, the client's sampling options, stream as the client asked, and the key in x-api-key as Anthropic's API defines; Claude-specific rewrites belong to the Claude provider extension (slice 10).
